# Event sheet 2
# Source: eventSheets/Event sheet 2.json

group "Second Layout Events" (active)
  static isActive: boolean = true

  block
    when: NavButton.on-clicked()
    when: System.compare-boolean-eventvar(variable=isActive)
    do: System.go-to-layout-by-name(layout="Main Layout")
    do: Text[Timer].stop-timer(tag="test")
